component.name: MindMapVault FOSS
component.summary: Encrypted mind maps that stay on your computer

description.p: MindMapVault FOSS is a mind mapping app for people who want their notes to stay private. Every map is encrypted on your computer before it is saved, and nothing ever leaves it: there is no account, no server and no telemetry.
This Flatpak has no network access at all, so the offline promise is enforced by the sandbox rather than taken on trust.

ul.li: Fast keyboard-driven editing: Tab for a child, Enter for a sibling
Notes, pictures and file attachments on nodes
Local profiles, each unlocked with its own password
Keep vaults in any folder, including one you sync yourself
Import and export FreeMind, Freeplane, XMind, WiseMapping and Markdown

description.p: An open source alternative to XMind and MindMeister.
